queue.question: Which current UE 5.8, SideFX Karma, and modern atmosphere/whole-atmosphere ideas are transferable into KAOPU as vendor-independent atmosphere/lighting semantics and evaluator contracts without copying engine implementations or defaults?
queue.progress: R01-R06 established state/evaluator separation, ground-to-space semantics, query-scoped evaluator validity, multi-root Earth references, evidence dependency, per-quantity validity, typed Missing/Unsupported, and split-overlap semantics. R07 locked Takram reference-frame/evaluator architecture. R08 defined typed Weather vertical coordinates. R09 separated coordinate conversion from spatial retarget and split RuntimeCloudPlacement, CloudOpticalClosure and EvaluatorBudget. R10 defined minimum CloudOpticalClosure sufficiency and identified NASA MERRA-2 source-native path optics as a lower-assumption global experiment route. R11 tested whether those source-native optical diagnostics are representationally sufficient for realtime local-volume rendering. Official NASA GMAO documentation shows M2T3NVCLD is a 3-hourly time-averaged, 72-model-level, 576x361 collection containing CLOUD, INCLOUDQI/INCLOUDQL and in-cloud optical thickness TAUCLI/TAUCLW; MERRA-2 is delayed global reanalysis rather than instantaneous operational Weather truth. The R11 probe passed 6/6 and demonstrates that temporal/spatial aggregation cannot be silently collapsed: E[exp(-tau)] != exp(-E[tau]), E[tau/dz] != E[tau]/E[dz], separately averaged CLOUD and in-cloud tau do not recover their joint state, and identical coarse mean/coverage can hide different temporal and spatial structures. Candidate AggregationSupportContract, RepresentativenessState, OperationKind.spatiotemporal_disaggregation and DerivedSyntheticDisaggregation now prevent source-native path optics from being promoted directly to instantaneous local 3-D cloud truth. No authenticated M2T3NVCLD NetCDF cloud values were materialized, so the Weather-coupling gate remains open and status stays candidate-partial. No production Mother branch was modified.
queue.nextGate: Keep three gates distinct. Physical-reference gate: authoritative NRLMSIS 2.1 numerical confirmation plus a tiny authenticated HITRAN checkpoint set. Runtime-atmosphere gate: one KAOPU ReferenceFrame + RuntimeAtmospherePacket consumed by two evaluator adapters. Weather-coupling gate: R11 adds aggregation/representativeness validity and rejects direct use of 3-hour coarse MERRA-2 path optics as instantaneous local-volume truth. Next either authenticate a small MERRA-2 M2T3NVCLD packet and preserve its AggregationSupportContract while testing one explicitly DerivedSyntheticDisaggregation adapter, or select a higher-temporal/higher-spatial source closer to realtime Weather support. In either route, feed the same derived local optical packet to at least two evaluator adapters and report source/model uncertainty, aggregation error, disaggregation uncertainty, optical-closure error, numerical/visual error and performance cost separately. Candidate-complete promotion requires all applicable gates; Frozen promotion remains a separate Judgment event.
